The '''Kalgo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained several inhabited worlds clustered around [[Kalgo 13]].
